assertion.statement: Argo CD v3.0.0 includes a revert of the change that added a check for user defined role referential integrity, so that check is not present in this release.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: The evidence is a single commit title; it does not state which RBAC policy constructs the check inspected (what counts as a reference to a user-defined role, or what counts as an undefined role) or under what conditions it triggered, so no condition over the environment's policy.csv / argocd-rbac-cm or any other configuration can be written.; consequence: The evidence does not state what the check did when it found a violation (reject a policy, warn, or fail startup), nor in which prior release it shipped, so the operational effect of its removal for an upgrading environment cannot be asserted.
